before: Live, compose split a run at the words of a decided move, by the move's name, where a fold reads no move and draws one run, so the saved file differed after a fold.
after: A move's name parts runs only while its revision draws the words, so live and after a fold the words of a decided move are saved in their run.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. Only the run boundaries compose writes for a decided move's words change; every copy composes with the same code version, so the copies agree. Checkpoints keep their form. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
